analysis.summaryJa: mustの核は話し手が今感じる「ほかに道がない」ほどの強い圧力であり、行動へ向けば義務、must notなら禁止、好意的に向けば強い勧め、証拠から結論へ向けば確信・推量になる。画像の圧力計と4方向の矢印、および過去の義務はhad toという時間帯を根拠に使い分ける。
grammarPoints: must doは話し手が強く感じる義務・必要
You must try ...は熱意ある強い勧め
must be・must haveは証拠に基づく強い推量
過去の客観的な義務はhad toで表す
visualEvidence: 中央の圧力計がMAXを指し、mustから4本の赤い矢印が伸びる
義務・必要、禁止、強いおすすめ、確信・推量の4区画がある
今ここで感じる強い圧力という核が示される
過去の義務はhad toという砂時計の帯がある
commonTraps: must notを「～する必要がない」と誤解する
過去の具体的義務にmustedやmustを使う
証拠からのmust beを義務として訳す
mustの後ろにtoや三単現-sを付ける

questions.prompt: All contractors must ------- the safety briefing before entering the site.
questions.translationJa: 請負業者は全員、現場へ入る前に安全説明を修了しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 強い義務をmust＋原形completeで表します。

questions.prompt: Visitors must ------- touch the laboratory equipment.
questions.translationJa: 来訪者は研究機器に触れてはいけません。
questions.explanationJa: must not＋原形は強い禁止を表します。

questions.prompt: You must ------- the new bakery across from the station.
questions.translationJa: 駅向かいの新しいパン屋をぜひ試してみてください。
questions.explanationJa: 好意的な強い勧めにもmust＋原形を使えます。

questions.prompt: The conference room is dark; the meeting must ------- over.
questions.translationJa: 会議室が暗いので、会議は終わったに違いありません。
questions.explanationJa: 見える証拠からの強い結論をmust beで表します。

questions.prompt: We ------- cancel yesterday’s tour because of the storm.
questions.translationJa: 嵐のため、私たちは昨日のツアーを中止しなければなりませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: yesterdayの過去の必要にはhad toを使います。

questions.prompt: The total is twice the estimate, so there must ------- a calculation error.
questions.translationJa: 合計が見積の2倍なので、計算ミスがあるに違いありません。
questions.explanationJa: 存在するという強い推量をthere must beで表します。

questions.prompt: Employees must not ------- emergency exits with boxes.
questions.translationJa: 従業員は箱で非常口をふさいではいけません。
questions.explanationJa: 禁止のmust notの後ろは原形blockです。

questions.prompt: You must ------- our rooftop restaurant while you are in town.
questions.translationJa: 滞在中にぜひ当ホテルの屋上レストランへお越しください。
questions.explanationJa: サービス上の熱意ある勧めをmust visitで表します。

questions.prompt: Ms. Patel knows the confidential code, so she must ------- on the project team.
questions.translationJa: パテルさんは機密コードを知っているので、プロジェクトチームの一員に違いありません。
questions.explanationJa: 証拠からの確信をmust be＋前置詞句で表します。

questions.prompt: The branch ------- replace its fire alarm after last year’s inspection.
questions.translationJa: その支店は昨年の点検後、火災報知器を交換しなければなりませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の検査結果による必要にはhad toを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence stating a requirement.

choices.A: Staff must locks the archive each evening.

choices.C: Staff do must lock the archive each evening.
choices.D: Staff must lock the archive each evening.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence stating a prohibition.

choices.D: Passengers must no leave bags in the aisle.

questions.translationJa: 乗客は通路にかばんを置いてはいけません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence giving an enthusiastic recommendation.

choices.C: You must see the design exhibit before it closes.

questions.translationJa: 終了前にぜひそのデザイン展をご覧ください。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence making a strong deduction from evidence.

choices.A: The printer must be out of paper; the warning light is on.
choices.B: The printer must is out of paper; the warning light is on.
choices.C: The printer must out of paper; the warning light is on.
choices.D: The printer does must be out of paper.

questions.translationJa: 警告灯が点いているので、プリンターは用紙切れに違いありません。
questions.explanationJa: 証拠を根拠にmust be＋補語で強く推量します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a past necessity.

choices.A: We must relocate the workshop last Tuesday.
choices.B: We musted relocate the workshop last Tuesday.
choices.C: We had relocate to the workshop last Tuesday.
choices.D: We had to relocate the workshop last Tuesday.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは先週火曜日、研修会場を変更しなければなりませんでした。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct statement of a safety rule.

choices.A: Drivers must not exceeds the posted speed limit.
choices.B: Drivers do must not exceed the speed limit.
choices.C: Drivers must not exceed the posted speed limit.
choices.D: Drivers must no exceeding the speed limit.

questions.translationJa: 運転手は掲示された制限速度を超えてはいけません。
questions.explanationJa: must not＋原形exceedで禁止を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence giving a friendly strong recommendation.

choices.A: You must to try the chef’s seasonal lunch.
choices.B: You must try the chef’s seasonal lunch.

questions.translationJa: シェフの季節限定ランチをぜひお試しください。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct deduction about an absent employee.

choices.A: Mr. Diaz must is working from home today.
choices.B: Mr. Diaz must working from home today.
choices.C: Mr. Diaz does must be working from home.
choices.D: Mr. Diaz must be working from home today.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct past-obligation sentence.

choices.A: The hotel must close its pool during the repair last week.
choices.B: The hotel had to closed its pool during the repair.
choices.C: The hotel had to close its pool during the repair.
choices.D: The hotel musted close its pool during the repair.

questions.translationJa: ホテルは修理中、プールを閉鎖しなければなりませんでした。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct deduction about a price difference.

choices.A: There must be an extra service charge on this bill.
choices.B: There must have an extra service charge on this bill.
choices.C: There must is an extra service charge on this bill.
choices.D: There does must be an extra charge on this bill.

questions.translationJa: この請求書には追加サービス料があるに違いありません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Employees must display identification."

choices.A: Displaying identification is mandatory for employees.

questions.translationJa: 従業員は身分証を表示することが義務付けられています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Guests must not enter this corridor."

choices.A: Guests do not need to enter this corridor.
choices.B: Guests may enter with a map.
choices.C: The corridor must be open to guests.
choices.D: Guests are prohibited from entering this corridor.

questions.translationJa: 宿泊客はこの廊下へ入ることを禁止されています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "You must visit the local market."

choices.A: The law requires every visitor to use the market.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The caller must be Mr. Ito."

choices.A: Mr. Ito is required to make a call.
choices.B: The speaker is almost certain that the caller is Mr. Ito.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は電話の相手が伊藤さんだとほぼ確信しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We had to replace the lock yesterday."

choices.A: Replacing the lock was necessary yesterday.
choices.B: We are required to replace the lock tomorrow.

questions.translationJa: 昨日、鍵を交換する必要がありました。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "You must not disclose these figures."

choices.A: You are not required to disclose the figures.
choices.C: Disclosure of these figures is strictly forbidden.
choices.D: You may disclose the figures later.

questions.translationJa: これらの数値の開示は厳しく禁止されています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "You must try the new customer portal."

choices.D: The speaker enthusiastically recommends the new portal.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は新しい顧客ポータルを熱心に勧めています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The train must have left already."

choices.A: The speaker is strongly convinced that the train has departed.
choices.B: The train is required to leave later.
choices.C: The train cannot leave the station.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は列車がすでに出発したと強く確信しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The store had to reduce its hours last winter."

choices.A: The store must reduce its hours next winter.

choices.C: The store was prohibited from changing its hours.
choices.D: The store may have longer hours now.

questions.translationJa: 昨冬は事情により営業時間を短縮する必要がありました。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "There must be another copy in the archive."

choices.A: Another copy is required to enter the archive.
choices.B: The archive may not contain any copy.
choices.C: The speaker is nearly certain that another copy exists there.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は資料庫に別の写しがあるとほぼ確信しています。
questions.explanationJa: there must beは存在についての強い推量です。

questions.prompt: The laboratory contains sensitive equipment. Visitors must ------- with an employee at all times.
questions.translationJa: 研究室には精密機器があり、来訪者は常に従業員と一緒にいなければなりません。

questions.prompt: This door is a fire exit. Staff must ------- lock it while the building is occupied.
questions.translationJa: この扉は非常口なので、建物の使用中は職員が施錠してはいけません。

questions.prompt: The museum has a rare photography exhibit this week. You must ------- it before Friday.
questions.translationJa: 今週その美術館で貴重な写真展があり、金曜日までにぜひ見るべきです。
questions.explanationJa: 価値ある体験を熱心に勧めるmust seeです。

questions.prompt: The floor is wet and a mop is nearby. A cleaner must ------- working in this area.
questions.translationJa: 床がぬれており、近くにモップがあります。清掃員がこの区域で作業中に違いありません。
questions.explanationJa: 証拠から現在進行中の状況をmust be workingと推量します。

questions.prompt: A water pipe burst last night. The hotel ------- move several guests to another floor.
questions.translationJa: 昨夜水道管が破裂し、ホテルは複数の宿泊客を別の階へ移さなければなりませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: last nightの過去の必要にはhad toを用います。

questions.prompt: The sign says “Authorized Personnel Only.” Customers must ------- go beyond this point.
questions.translationJa: 標識には「関係者以外立入禁止」とあり、顧客はここから先へ進んではいけません。

questions.prompt: The regional food fair is famous for its desserts. You must ------- the apple tart.
questions.translationJa: 地域の食の催しはデザートで有名なので、アップルタルトをぜひ味わってください。

questions.prompt: All meeting rooms are booked, and the lobby is crowded. A large event must ------- taking place.
questions.translationJa: 会議室はすべて予約済みでロビーも混雑しています。大規模な催しが行われているに違いありません。

questions.prompt: The elevator failed its inspection last month. The building manager ------- shut it down immediately.
questions.translationJa: エレベーターは先月の点検に不合格となり、管理者は直ちに停止しなければなりませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: last monthの客観的な必要はhad to＋原形shutです。

questions.prompt: The subtotal is correct, but the final amount is higher. There must ------- an additional fee.
questions.translationJa: 小計は正しいのに最終金額が高いため、追加料金があるに違いありません。
questions.explanationJa: 差額という証拠から存在をthere must beで推量します。
